title: FALCA: Falsification-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Hierarchical Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Deep Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.28361v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon deep search requires LLM agents to iteratively decompose complex information needs, gather evidence from external sources, and maintain a reliable research state under multiple constraints. A central challenge is that early mistakes can be amplified over the search trajectory: agents may anchor on an incorrect candidate, collect partially supporting evidence, overlook contradictions, and accumulate errors that misguide subsequent reasoning. We propose FALCA, a falsification-aware framework that formulates deep search as a propose-falsify process. FALCA adopts a collaborative Searcher-Falsifier architecture, where the Searcher proposes candidate answers or sub-answers, while independent Falsifiers actively seek counterevidence, check unmet constraints, identify conflicts, and produce concise falsification reports for research-state revision. translated_abstract: 长程深度搜索要求大语言模型（LLM）智能体迭代地分解复杂的信息需求，从外部来源收集证据，并在多重约束下维持可靠的研究状态。一个核心挑战是早期错误会在搜索轨迹中被不断放大：智能体可能锚定于错误的候选答案、收集仅部分支持的证据、忽视矛盾之处，并累积误导后续推理的错误。我们提出FALCA，一个证伪感知框架，将深度搜索形式化为“提出-证伪”过程。FALCA采用协作式的Searcher-Falsifier（搜索者-证伪者）架构：Searcher提出候选答案或子答案，而独立的Falsifiers则主动寻找反证、检查未满足的约束、识别冲突，并生成简明的证伪报告以修正研究状态。为强化这一循环，我们引入证伪感知训练，将SFT预热与……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出FALCA框架，通过Searcher-Falsifier协同架构将长程深度搜索建模为“提出-证伪”过程，并采用带分层信用分配的证伪感知强化学习，有效防止早期错误在搜索轨迹中累积放大。
en_tdlr: FALCA formulates long-horizon deep search as a propose-falsify process via a collaborative Searcher-Falsifier architecture, combined with falsification-aware reinforcement learning and hierarchical credit assignment to prevent early errors from amplifying over the search trajectory.
